shadcn.description: shadcn/ui registry access -- component search and metadata lookup

serena.description: Semantic codebase analysis -- symbol search, go-to-definition, and reference tracing

playwright.description: Browser automation -- local web app testing, screenshots, and console log inspection

jira.description: Jira ticket search, retrieval, and status updates (bsizeinc.atlassian.net)

notion.description: Notion page and database read/write - PRDs, specs, and meeting notes

figma.description: Figma design context extraction - layout hierarchy, design tokens, Auto Layout rules, component variants

miro.description: Miro board reading - user flows, page transition rules, PRD, system architecture diagrams

markitdown.description: File-to-Markdown converter (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML) -- extracts text and document structure only. Use for prose-based design specs where values are written out (e.g. 'Primary color: #2563EB'). Does NOT extract visual styling (colors, font sizes, spacing) from binary or image-based files -- use Claude Vision (Read tool) for those.
